 At Jammu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Through: Mr. G. S. Thakur, Advocate.

Vs
Ut of J&K and Ors. ..... Respondent(s)
 Through: Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. Aag.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order
11.09.2023 This writ petition is getting its short disposal.

01. The petitioners herein claim to be the owners whose lands came to be subject matter of acquisition in a final award no. SDM/M/CLA/209- 20/09-10 dated 10.04.2019 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub- Divisional Magistrate), Mahore under the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990.
02.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition (Sub- Divisional Magistrate), Mahore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The petitioners submit that being dissatisfied with the quantum of the compensation so awarded in terms of the said award which did not reckon the loss of standing trees upon the land so acquired,
they sought reference from the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore by submitting a written application within time but the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore has chosen to sit upon the said application of the petitioners without any rhyme and reason thereby constraining them to no other course of option except to petition this Court with the present writ petition.
03.

In this regard, the petitioners draw the attention of this Court that similarly situated land owners covered under the said award came to approach this Court through writ petition WP(C) no.
824/2020 titled - Mohd Yousaf And Ors vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137852293/
1 "Nek Ram & Anr. Vs UT of Jammu and Kashmir & Ors." which came to be disposed of by the Hon'ble Division Bench in terms of an order dated 14.03.2023 thereby directing the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub- Divisional Magistrate), Mahore to do the needful for making reference to the Court under section 18 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 with respect to claim of the persons who were petitioners in said WP(C) no. 824/2020.
04.

entities.text: Mohd Yousaf And Ors vs Ut Of J&K And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Nek Ram & Anr. Vs UT of Jammu and Kashmir & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition (Sub- Divisional Magistrate), Mahore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
It is reported that the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore has accordingly acted in compliance with direction of the Hon'ble Division Bench by making a reference under section 18 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 but with respect to the petitioners the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore is not acting on his own initiative and, as such, the direction of like nature as given in writ petition WP(C) no. 824/2020 is required to be imparted in the present case as well.
05.
This Court sees no prejudice whatsoever being caused in the matter to the respondents by issuing an identical direction as given in WP(C) no. 824/2020 by the Hon'ble Division Bench.

06. Accordingly, it is directed unto the respondent no. 2 - the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore to examine the application so filed by the petitioners before him for seeking reference under section 18 of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 and in case if the same is in accordance with law being in its period of limitation as prescribed then to make the requisite reference under section 18 of the J&K State Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 to the competent reference court.

entities.text: J&K State Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 07. The present writ petition is, accordingly disposed of.
08. Needful be done by the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub- Divisional Magistrate), Mahore within a period of three weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is received by him.

Otherwise also, this order is being passed in presence of Mrs. Monika Kohli, the learned Sr. AAG and, as such,
the Collector Land Acquisition (Sub-Divisional Magistrate), Mahore is deemed to have been notified for him to carry out the needful at his end even before getting certified copy of this order served upon him by the petitioners.
Disposed of.
